extension.description: A configurable video add-on for Kodi. Browse categories, search, keep favorites and a resume-aware watch history, and play from a content source you configure. Content-source agnostic: point it at your own JSON API or HTML source.
extension.news: v1.1.4 - Preview images: videos may now include an optional "preview" URL (a still or animated frame). When provided it is shown as the listing's fanart/background image so the video content is identifiable at a glance; "thumb" remains the poster thumbnail. v1.1.3 - Docs only: README notes that tools/termux_bootstrap.sh now installs a Termux:Boot autostart hook, so the reference backend and sshd survive a device reboot without reopening Termux.
